newsitem.title: USA: Urban Shopping wins Saudi Arabia contract.
newsitem.headline: Urban Shopping wins Saudi Arabia contract.

text.p: Urban Shopping Centers Inc said it won a contract to provide feasibility and design consulting for Al Faisaliah Center, a project currently under development in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia which includes retail space, an office tower, apartments and a hotel.
The three-level center will include 250,000 square feet of retail space for about 80 tenants. Construction of the project has begun and will be completed in two years.
The owner of the project is the King Faisal Foundation.
Urban Shopping said it and the King Faisal Foundation will jointly develop a strategy for retail leasing and management activities throughout the Persian Gulf region.
Urban Shopping is a self-administered real estate investment trust which owns, acquires, manages, leases, and develops super-regional and regional malls.
The value of the consulting contract was not disclosed.
